$comment: antd Popover call sites still to migrate. One entry per file — the debt is a whole-file import, not a single code path. Delete an entry in the same commit that migrates its file: a stale entry fails the guard, which is what keeps this list from becoming a permanent exemption. This file lives outside platform/ui/components on purpose: a caller migrating a site must be able to strike its line without touching the component directory, and the guard reads this file as the only copy.
$decidedComment: Reviewed and deliberately kept, not debt. A line here says "we looked and decided", so nobody re-opens the discussion; a line in `entries` says "still to do". If the file stops importing antd Popover, delete its line here too — a decided entry that no longer matches the code is the same lie as a stale debt entry.

apps/desktop-shell/src/renderer/src/shel.reason: A picker, not an explanation panel: controlled open state, search, category and protocol filters, a result list. The component takes one sentence and a focusable trigger; putting a choose-something panel where the sentence goes either drops half its function or opens an arbitrary-content API for a single site. Revisit only when a second site needs custom content in a floating layer; then both move together.
